steps.speaker: Technician A
steps.content: ...What's with this sudden new operation? Hasn't the dark web threat already been neutralized? That Mania space is completely closed. There's no risk anymore, so what's there to be scared about?

steps.speaker: Technician B
steps.content: It seems the MBCC wants to arrest the offending Sinner... but isn't she already dead? Moore's report explained as much.
Rise had already submitted her resignation, and is only back today at Chief ${PlayerName}'s request to support this so-called special operation... but even she doesn't know what it is.
The MBCC Chief is staring silently at the surveillance screen, his face uncharacteristically grim.
steps.female_content: The MBCC Chief is staring silently at the surveillance screen, her face uncharacteristically grim.

steps.content: [Entering Memory]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The various reports have sufficiently explained the malicious incident caused by Sinner 000, so I won't elaborate further.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The offending Sinner has died from severe injuries. The impact and chaos she caused are gradually subsiding.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now, I want the truth behind it all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Please delve into DisCity's dark web, track the early activities of Sinner 000, and investigate the origin of Mania. I want to know what, or who, created such an "incident" through contamination.
[Exit Memory]

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: The results have been compiled. Residual info from Sinner 000 points to an unknown area in DisCity's dark web, where a large amount of Mania data has been detected. The environment is very unstable there, and we cannot delve further with conventional methods.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Enter the domain. I want to browse all the residual info there.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: No, it's too risky!
She steps forward and grabs your hand.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Hey, at these depths, the information pollution in the dark web is Mania. Don't try to understand it, or it will distort your mind.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: You didn't bring me here just to show me this, did you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need the most trustworthy and professional partner on this matter. I need your help.
You pause and smile at her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Of course, soon you'll also need my help.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: ? You...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm aware of the risks. This time, the login and browsing will all be done in the isolation room. Please prepare the necessary contamination protection measures for me. If there are any unexpected issues, I'll need you guys to handle them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Moore, open the channel and send me in. You know the way, right?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Of course. I went ahead and prepared the temporary access protocol. I can send you to the nearest accessible domain.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: But from there on, you'll have to go on your own. Are you sure you're okay with that?
At the other end of the conference hall, a few suited men with hats pulled low linger in the shadows by the wall. They make Rise uneasy.

She also notices things are a little strange between ${PlayerName} and Moore. They’ve been exchanging a lot more silent glances today. Just like in this moment—Moore gave the final command, took a sip of coffee, and smiled at ${PlayerName}.
Several seconds pass before Chief finally speaks.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Experts are needed outside to handle the emergencies, and Miss Moore is the most reliable when it comes to technical matters. Can I leave this in your hands?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Alright, decryption complete. The address is ready, and the link is being generated. Ready to dive into the depths of the data sea, Chief?
You walk into the specially designed server room, establish communication, and enter the depths of DisCity's dark web.
For a moment, the screen fills with countless characters. After a while, you begin to understand their meaning. At the same time...

The display starts to distort in front of you. Your senses begin to shift, and you fall into chaos. Your consciousness seems to leave your body, merging into the character-filled screen, delving deeper... until another bizarre world unfolds before you.
The first to greet you are some digitalized Corruptors from DisCity's dark web. You've become very familiar with them over the past six months.
